Sightings listed on the page: (F-8), (L-8), (L-9), (H-4), (E-10) in front of the Armor Shop, (E-11), (I-4) -- three here, two near the boxes and one towards the back of a tent, (J-10) next to Dunbaff, (G-4) -- two here, one just behind the I.M. and one against the wall.

notes:
RANK GATE: Campaign Rank is 'Brass Ribbon of Service §§'. Recorded here and flagged, not written to gates.level -- Level is empty, so gates.level is null. Unit Requirement is '3-6 members.', which the schema has no field for either.

TIME: the header's Time field is EMPTY, but bullet 3 says 'The battle is capped at 30 minutes'. Both nation siblings state it in the header (Granite Rose I (S) and Granite Rose I (B) both read 'Time: 30 min.'), so the empty field here is an omission on this page rather than a claim that there is no cap. The cap is on the battlefield, not on getting there. Flagged time_gated; the schema has no time field, so it lives here.

THE 3 YAGUDO ARE NOT NAMED, SO mobs IS []. Bullets 2 and 5 say only 'defeat 3 Yagudo'. 'Yagudo' is a beastman family, not a mob name, and anything written into a mob name becomes a live kill key with nothing validating it, so the count of 3 is recorded in the step note instead of guessed into a name. The siblings do not rescue this: Granite Rose I (S) names 'Orc Stormers' and Granite Rose I (B) says '3 Quadavs', both nation-specific, and neither tells us what the Windurst battlefield's Yagudo are called. Flagged unnamed_target.

THE ENTRY POINT IS ALSO UNNAMED. Bullet 1 says 'the Fortilice at L-9 in Sauromugue Champaign (S)'. The siblings spell the same structure 'Fortilace' (Granite Rose I (S) bullet 2, Granite Rose I (B) bullet 1), so the wiki is not consistent about the word and I cannot show it is the entity's in-game name -- it reads as the zone's fortification. Rather than mint a marker key that may never draw, step 2's target is {type: none, name: null} with the wording in the note; the zone and grid the page gives are what actually locate that rung.

BATTLEFIELD ZONE: the walkthrough only ever says 'the BCNM'. The header Description names it -- 'a large battalion of beastman raiders has been dispatched to [[Ghoyu's Reverie]]' -- so Ghoyu's Reverie is from this page, not a sibling. (The same Description misspells the approach as 'the Sauromogue Champaign'; bullet 1's 'Sauromugue Champaign (S)' is the correct and resolvable form and is what is recorded.)

RETURN STEP KEPT, AND IT IS BURIED. Bullet 6 is mostly commentary about party leaders and nations, but it ends 'Those signed up for this Campaign Ops will receive 640 Allied Notes upon speaking to Emhi Tchaoryo' -- that is the hand-in, and dropping it because the bullet does not begin with 'Return to' would have left the op looking complete at the battlefield exit. Bullet 4 (buffs survive entry) is not a rung.

EXIT SPELLING: bullet 5 says 'Dawn Aureole'; the (S) and (B) siblings both write 'Dawn Aureola'. This page's spelling is used, since it is the page being read; flagged name_spelling_variant so the resolver mismatch is visible if it draws nothing.

steps.note: bullet 1 opens 'After speaking with Emhi Tchaoryo'.

go to what bullet 1 calls 'the Fortilice' at (L-9) in Sauromugue Champaign (S) -- the zone's fortification, which the siblings spell 'Fortilace'; not recorded as a target name because the spelling is inconsistent and it is not shown to be the entity's own name. The zone and grid are the page's own and are what locate this rung. Party leader selects to enter (bullet 2's context).

enter the BCNM and defeat 3 Yagudo. The page never names the three, so mobs is [] rather than a guessed kill key -- the count of 3 is here. The battlefield is capped at 30 minutes (bullet 3); bullet 4 adds that buffs cast before entering survive. leave through the Dawn Aureole. This page spells it 'Aureole'; the (S) and (B) siblings spell it 'Aureola'.

the hand-in, stated at the end of bullet 6: the 170 XP is paid to everyone on completing the BCNM, but 'Those signed up for this Campaign Ops will receive 640 Allied Notes upon speaking to Emhi Tchaoryo.' The rest of bullet 6 -- only the leader needs the orders, anyone of any nation may help -- is commentary.

notes:
RANK GATE: Campaign Rank is 'Brass Ribbon of Service §§'. Recorded here and flagged, not put in gates.level -- Level is 'Any', so gates.level is null.

THE PAGE CONTRADICTS ITSELF ABOUT TIME, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS MEDIUM. The header says 'Time: 30 minutes'; the Notes section's bullet 1 says 'There seems to be no time limit to how long you can take to get to Everbloom Hollow.' Read charitably the two are about different clocks -- a 30 minute cap inside the battlefield and no clock on the journey -- and the sibling Pit Spider I (W) says exactly that in words ('Time: 30 min in BC'). But this page never says so itself, so the contradiction stands on its face and the record is demoted rather than smoothed over. The schema has no time field either way; flagged time_gated.

THE MOBS ARE NAMED, so they are recorded with counts from the page: Orcish Carrier x1 and Orcish Grunt x2, the three that bullet 4 calls 'a line of 3 Orcs'. The Carrier is the one that matters -- it runs for the exit and reaching it fails the op -- but both are kill targets and both counts come off the page's own sub-bullets.

THE EXIT IS A RUNG, NOT A FORMALITY. Bullet 6 is bolded on the wiki -- 'Exit at the Twilight Aureole to complete the mission' -- and the Notes repeat it, and list 'Warping out directly after killing the Orcs' as a way to FAIL. Killing the orcs completes the objective (bullet 5) but not the mission, so the exit gets its own step.

RETURN STEP KEPT: bullet 7, 'Return and talk to Rasdinice for your reward.'

ZONES: Vunkerl Inlet (S) and Everbloom Hollow are both the page's own spellings and both resolve. The (S) here is load-bearing -- bare 'Vunkerl Inlet' resolves to nothing at all, so it would be dropped.

NOT STEPS: the Notes section entirely (sleepability, ~2500 HP each, the two failure conditions, the repeat of the exit instruction) and the Map image.

the Beastman Ensign at (J-7) in Vunkerl Inlet (S) is the entry point; once the party leader selects to enter you are transported into Everbloom Hollow. The page wikilinks [[Beastman Ensign]], so the name is its own. Note the (B) sibling spells the same structure 'Beastmen Ensign'.

three orcs start running for the exit the moment you arrive. Kill the Orcish Carrier first -- it occasionally flees mid-fight and the mission fails if it reaches the far end of the area; the two Orcish Grunts link with it and do not run. All three are susceptible to Sleep and Gravity. Killing all three completes the Mission Objective but NOT the mission -- see step 4.
bolded on the page: exit at the Twilight Aureole to complete the mission. Warping out straight after the kills is listed in the Notes as a way to fail, so this is a real rung.
bullet 7: 'Return and talk to Rasdinice for your reward.'

GRID CONFLICT, CORRECTED FROM SIBLINGS AND SAID SO. This header says 'pos: I-9' for Hieronymus in Bastok Markets (S). Every other Bastok page in this batch and its neighbours -- Aegis Scream I (B), Smokescreen I (B), Streetsweeper I (B), Materiel Storm I (B), Granite Rose I (B), Hawk Eye I (B), Slaughterhouse I (B) -- puts Hieronymus at E-8, and I-9 is Rasdinice's position in Southern San d'Oria (S), which is exactly what the (S) twin of this very page carries. It is a copy-paste. E-8 is used on the steps; start.raw keeps the header's I-9 verbatim so the conflict remains visible. Flagged grid_conflict, and this is one reason the record is medium.

ZONE NORMALISED: bullet 2 and the Description both write '[[Grauberg]]'. The resolvable Wings-of-the-Goddess form is 'Grauberg (S)', and that is what is recorded. I checked with the runtime resolver: here both spellings happen to land on zone 89, because Grauberg exists only in the past -- but the (S) form is what the rest of the corpus uses and what makes the record self-consistent with the other zones in this batch, where the suffix is not optional (bare 'Vunkerl Inlet' and 'Fort Karugo-Narugo' resolve to nothing, and bare 'Bastok Markets' resolves to the present-day city). Flagged zone_normalised.

THE THREE QUADAVS ARE NOT NAMED, SO mobs IS []. Bullet 4 says 'A party of 3 Quadavs, 2 soldiers and 1 caravaneer' -- a family plus two role words, none of them a mob name, and 'the Caravaneer' in the sub-bullets is that role capitalised rather than a proper name. The (S) sibling names its three (Orcish Carrier, Orcish Grunt x2) but those are the San d'Orian battlefield's orcs and say nothing about this one, so nothing is borrowed. The count of 3, and the fact that only the two soldiers fight while the caravaneer runs for the exit, are in the step note. Flagged unnamed_target.

THE EXIT IS A RUNG. Bullet 6 is emphasised on the wiki: 'You must exit the area by using the Twilight Aureola for Hieronymus to acknowledge the mission as successful!' -- so defeating the Quadavs completes the objective (bullet 5) but not the op. This page spells it 'Aureola'; the (S) twin spells it 'Aureole'. Each page's own spelling is kept.
